transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having a hard time keeping things straight lately. What finally pushed me to come in is... I just can't seem to organize all the moving parts anymore. 

Between work stuff like patent notes and team decisions, and then workshop prep, gallery deadlines... it's just a lot. I end up just... starting whatever is loudest, I guess. Instead of what actually matters. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Are you having trouble completing tasks at work or in your personal life because of these organizational difficulties?

Yeah... mostly at work. It's, um... it's starting to affect how people see me there. 

I missed a checkpoint on a patent filing recently. And... we had a pretty difficult architecture review, and I just wasn't... anyway, it didn't go well. It left my collaborators questioning if I can actually lead the larger project. So... yeah. It's causing some damage to my reputation.
Do you find yourself easily distracted during tasks?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... little things, mostly. Like if Slack pings, or... a browser tab flashes. Or even just... I don't know, a visual idea pops into my head. I'll lose the thread of what I was coding. And then I realize I just spent twenty minutes following some... unrelated design rabbit hole. So... yes.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. 

Like, if I'm on a long design call... I just get this... this pressure. Like I need to move. So I end up pacing around my office. Or just... shifting around a lot in my chair. Even when I'm trying to look like I'm paying attention. So... yeah. I guess I do.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really an impulsive person. I usually think about things before I do them... so, no.
Do you experience these difficulties with organization and distraction at home or in your personal activities, not just at work?
I don't know. I guess... maybe? I mean, I haven't really thought about it. I just try to get through the day. So... I'm not sure.
Do you have trouble staying focused or following through on tasks when you're doing things you enjoy?
Not really. I mean... if it's something I actually want to do, I'm usually fine. I can just do it. So, no, not really.
Do you experience difficulties with organization and distraction when you are not working?
Didn't you... I think you just asked me that. Like I said, I don't really know. I haven't paid much attention to it when I'm off the clock.
Are you having these organizational difficulties and distractions only during work hours or also on weekends or days off?
I thought we just covered this. Like I said... I don't really know. I haven't noticed.
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction are mainly related to your work stress or do they also happen in other areas of your life?
I... look, I really don't have a different answer for you. You keep asking the same thing. Like I just said, I don't know. I haven't tracked it.
Do you have trouble organizing your thoughts or tasks when you're on vacation or completely away from work?
I... I don't know why we're still on this. I really don't. Vacation, weekends, days off... it's all the same answer. I just don't know. I haven't paid attention to it.
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction happen in quiet, low-stress environments?

I... look, I'm not sure how else to say it. Changing the words around isn't going to change my answer. I really haven't kept a log of what the environment is like when it happens. I just can't give you a specific answer here.
Do you experience difficulties with organization and distraction when you are in a quiet room alone?

I... look, we're just going in circles now. A quiet room, a loud room... I don't know. I don't sit there and analyze my focus based on the noise level or who's in the room with me. I just don't have the data you're looking for. Can we please just move on to something else?
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction have been present for as long as you can remember?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... looking back, it was there in grade school. My parents kept old report cards and... teachers always wrote the same things. Said I was bright but daydreamed a lot. I'd finish assignments and just... forget to turn them in. Or lose my homework folders. That was all way before I was even a teenager. So, yeah. It's been a while.
Are your difficulties with organization and distraction limited to when you're working on complex tasks?
I don't really know. I mean... I guess it happens with easy things too. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you have trouble organizing tasks or staying focused when doing everyday chores at home?
I haven't really noticed. It's just... stuff around the house. I don't really pay attention to how focused I am when I'm doing the dishes or whatever. It just gets done when it gets done, I guess.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you didn't struggle with organization and distraction?
Not that I can think of. I mean... maybe there were times it wasn't as noticeable, but... I don't know. I haven't really kept track of it. It just feels like it's always kind of been this way.
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction happen at home with your family as well?
I suppose. I mean... I haven't really asked them about it. We just kind of... go about our day. They haven't really brought it up, so I don't know.
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction happen in situations where you're relaxed and not under any deadline?
I don't really know. I guess... I mean, if I'm just relaxing, I'm not really trying to organize anything anyway. I just sort of sit there. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you think your difficulties with organization and distraction happen consistently regardless of where you are or what you're doing?
I'm not really sure. I mean... I mostly just go to work and come home. I haven't really analyzed it across different places. It just... is what it is, I guess.
